payload.text: **LESSONS candidates from 2026-09-17 midday, vc's call at a fold.** (z) vc relayed a peer's limit ("LFS objects arrive as pointers") into a design reply without measuring it; a two-minute probe showed git archive smudges LFS, downloads a missing object and writes .git/lfs/objects -- a limit is a claim too. (aa) A peer wrote "the check I asked you to add"; neither the inbox nor the session held the ask, and the peer then found it only in an unsent draft -- check the record before building on a remembered agreement. (bb) vc proposed a generic rule (re-root every exported value under the project root) without walking its population; HOME and TMPDIR can sit under a root, and it was withdrawn one message later -- a generic rule's population includes what you do not own. (cc) A pattern's anchors are mutations too: dc's review found the optional unit, and measuring the same line found both anchors unheld.
